messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=hosted-inference-prod (INC-5018). Symptoms: sustained p95 > 900ms and 5xx spike > 4% in last 2m.
pagerduty: Routing: primary on-call Samir. If unacked in 3m, escalate to secondary @Ava, then manager @Diego.
Samir: seeing alert on phone, will jump on laptop. currently on short DND, hopefully can ack.
Ava: Im available if escalated, driving but can join via phone.
ops-bot: Runbook recommendation: inference/p1-latency-spike. First mitigation: set model-fallback to cpu-quantized and increase autoscaler headroom.
Samir: acked INC-5018 at 3162223334.002. joining bridge. initial checks: gateway errors are 504s, model-hosts showing high GC pause in logs.
Rina: recent runtime change at 11:03 enabled aggressive tensor cache compaction (flag tensor_cache.compact=true). Could that cause GC pressure?
Diego: I'm on-call manager standby, ready to jump if escalated.
pagerduty: Primary ack by Samir. No escalation needed at this time.
Samir: tail logs:```[11:07:12] runtime_gc.cc: heavy pause 1123ms; heap grow request rejected``` Suspect compaction causing long stop-the-world pauses under heavy load.
Ava: can we flip the compaction flag to false? doing a staged flip to 10% of model-hosts. Command: ```infractl set-flag --name tensor_cache.compact --value false --percent 10```
ops-bot: Flag change requested by Ava at 3162223334.004. 10% rollout started.
Samir: after 30s the 10% hosts show improved p95. But overall p95 still >800ms. Autoscaler is scaling out but new hosts join slowly.
Rina: there's an ongoing large customer job (CUST-341 batch eval) that's creating long-running pinned sessions on a subset of nodes. Possibly raising overall GC pressure.
Diego: manager escalation fired automatically because PD policy has manager notify if incident active > 7m. PagerDuty: paging manager @Diego at 3162223334.006.
Diego: here. quick ask: can we identify and throttle the long-running CUST-341 job?
Ava: yes, I can identify sessions: job ids: batch-8793, batch-8794. I'll add a temporary rate-limit to batch scheduler for those jobs.
Samir: implementing scheduler throttle:```schedulerctl throttle --job batch-8793 --rate 0.2rps```
ops-bot: Command executed by Samir at 3162223334.006. batch-8793/8794 throttled.
Rina: after throttle, p95 improved to ~600ms within 90s and 5xxs dropping. However, some nodes still have long GC cycles.
Ava: next mitigation: increase JVM/gc heap headroom on model-host pool. I'll bump memory reserve on pool mh-pool-a by +1Gi. Doing now.
Samir: bumped reserves. observed fewer oom/kills; model hosts stable.
Diego: manager note: we should add an immediate mitigation to PD escalation policy to reduce noisy manager pages for transient >10m incidents while a mitigation is in progress. Setting a 15m quiet window for managers.
pagerduty: Quiet window applied by Diego for INC-5018 for 15m to prevent further manager escalations while stabilizing.
Ava: customer impact: approx 2% of realtime inference requests saw elevated latency and a few timed-out streams between 11:06-11:18 UTC. Customers CUST-341 and CUST-099 had the most hits. Support tickets created: SUP-9012, SUP-9013.
Rina: follow-up: patch in review to change tensor_cache.compact to be adaptive(thresholds) rather than always-on. PR #4527 assigned to Rina, ETA 4h.
Samir: action items I'm taking: 1) revert compaction flag fully if instability persists (pending), 2) add scheduler safeguards to block large batch jobs during peak traffic (in progress), 3) update runbook to include GC pause checks per host.
Diego: I'm assigning postmortem: Rina (root cause), Samir (mitigation timeline), Ava (customer comms). Please include metrics graphs and exact PD timeline.
ops-bot: Incident INC-5018 marked stable at 3162223334.009  condition: 5xx < 1% and p95 < 500ms for 10m.
Ava: leaving bridge in 15m if stable; will prepare customer blurb: "We experienced increased latency for a subset of Hosted Inference traffic due to a runtime compaction behavior interacting with large batch jobs. Engineers throttled offending jobs and adjusted host memory reservations to restore service. A postmortem will follow."
Samir: closing PD alert and creating incident stub: <https://redwood.incidents/INC-5018/postmortem>. Add anything I missed to the doc.
Diego: thanks team. good rapid coordination. please capture the sequence for the postmortem and add recommended deploy pipeline guardrails. :thumbsup:
